text:
I went here to get my medical certificate for my driver's license.

It was all quite simple: I presented my passport, they quickly took my blood pressure, and that was it. It costs 100 baht per license.

The clinic looks very clean and well-organized.

I waited a total of 30 minutes, but I didn't have to see a doctor.
